title: The cost of enforcing long-run coverage: a phase transition in online conformal prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.21542v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Consider an online prediction setting, where at each time, we are given a new feature vector and asked to provide a prediction interval or prediction set that will likely contain the corresponding response. In this setting, if the data points are i.i.d. (or more generally, exchangeable), conformal prediction provides a mechanism for building valid prediction sets around the output of any trained model, offering coverage probability $\geq 1-\alpha$ at each time $t$. In practice, however, issues such as distribution drift, changepoints, or other challenges may cause violations of the i.i.d. assumption. In this adversarial setting, online conformal prediction methods can still offer guarantees on long-run empirical coverage. translated_title: 强制长期覆盖率的代价：在线保形预测中的相变现象
translated_abstract: 考虑一个在线预测场景：在每个时刻，我们会收到一个新的特征向量，并被要求提供一个预测区间或预测集合，使其很可能包含对应的响应值。在这种场景下，如果数据点是独立同分布的（或更一般地，是可交换的），保形预测提供了一种机制，可以在任何已训练模型的输出周围构建有效的预测集合，在每个时刻 t 提供覆盖率 ≥ 1-α 的保证。然而在实践中，诸如分布漂移、变点或其他挑战可能导致独立同分布假设失效。在这种对抗性场景中，在线保形预测方法仍然可以对长期经验覆盖率提供保证。但是，这两类目标之间存在权衡：为了防范对抗性场景而对长期经验覆盖率施加严格约束，可能会导致瞬时覆盖出现不稳定的振荡（原摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文揭示了在线保形预测中存在一种相变现象：在对抗性场景下强制对长期经验覆盖率施加严格约束，会以瞬时覆盖出现不稳定的振荡为代价，从而刻画了长期覆盖与瞬时稳定之间的根本性权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a phase transition in online conformal prediction, showing that tightly enforcing long-run empirical coverage in adversarial settings comes at the cost of unstable oscillations in instantaneous coverage, revealing a fundamental trade-off between long-run coverage and instantaneous stability.
